main_commit.subject: G7-19F: acceptance integrity & worker coordination audit

phase_1_evidence_reconstructed.genuine_conflict_explanation: 4 conflicting paths × 2 workers (one record per (workerId, path) tuple); only package.json is identical; README.md, src/index.js, src/store.js, test/app.test.js have genuinely different content
phase_1_evidence_reconstructed.new_finding_packageIdentity_non_reproduc: computePackageIdentity includes .npm/* cache files (with timestamps in filenames), making the identity non-reproducible across runs. Documented in G7-19F report Remaining Limitations for future G7-20.

phase_2_acceptance_integrity.root_cause: 3-layer silent disappearance: (1) frozen goal compiler stores prose as hardConstraints strings (no auto-translation); (2) HTTP parser silently skipped command-type criteria pre-G7-19F; (3) transport type had no command variant pre-G7-19F; (4) buildChecks had no command branch pre-G7-19F; (5) verifier (frozen) already supported command checks natively, unchanged.
correction_implementation: src/runtime/acceptance-integrity.ts (NEW, 309 lines): detect executable-acceptance mentions in goal text; emit per-worker auto-added command checks using sh -c wrapper for verifier clean-room layout
src/gateway/types.ts: added command variant to AcceptanceCheckInput transport type
src/gateway/http-server.ts: added else-if branch to accept command-type criteria (no silent skip)
src/gateway/mission-service.ts: added goalContext + goalConstraints to MissionRuntime; modified buildChecks to propagate command + invoke auto-add
phase_2_acceptance_integrity.no_worker_produced_requiredFile_fallback: sentinel check: sh -c "echo G7-19F blocker: ... 1>&2; exit 1" — always fails honestly

phase_3_worker_coordination.evidence: two specialists produced duplicate complete applications because (A) brief tells each worker the FULL mission outcome (frozen renderTaskBrief); (B) writer's only upstream edge is via the coordinator which didn't run (NON-FROZEN buildEdges); (C) goal compiler over-extracted 4 capability needs (frozen).
phase_3_worker_coordination.targeted_correction_proposed: modify buildEdges in src/organization/organization-planner.ts (NON-FROZEN) to add direct handoff edges from each non-coordinator worker to the writer, even when a coordinator is present
phase_3_worker_coordination.reason_not_implemented: G7-19F brief says 'Only propose a targeted correction if the evidence proves a coordination defect'. Implementation deferred to focused G7-20 task with proper test coverage.

success_condition_met: YES — Genesis must not report an application as fully verified when an explicitly required executable acceptance check was omitted or failed. After G7-19F: (a) caller-supplied command checks no longer silently dropped (Parts 1-3); (b) uncovered executable-acceptance mentions in goal text are auto-translated into per-worker command checks (Part 4); (c) the verifier runs these checks and fails the mission honestly when the command fails (existing verifier behavior preserved).
